findings.finding: Engagement in social media can be fostered through direct calls to action asking followers to comment on their interests.
findings.qualification: Evidence includes observations of posts, but lacks independent verification of effectiveness.

findings.finding: Focus groups are utilized to gather feedback from agents in multiple countries for developing communication tools.
findings.qualification: Self-reported involvement in focus groups is unverified.

findings.finding: There is skepticism regarding the use of AI tools in real estate due to perceived complexity and questionable efficacy.

findings.finding: Understanding client psychology and asking the right questions are advised as essential elements in online sales communication.
findings.qualification: The advice is hypothetical and self-reported without corroborating studies or data.

findings.finding: Calls to comment based on shared experiences are used as a tactic to engage followers on social media platforms.
findings.qualification: Effectiveness is uncertain without verification or comparative analysis.

findings.finding: Agents are encouraged to optimize their sales process and use technology to convert more leads into opportunities.
